subject: Media Literacy
title: VPNs and Their Limits
description: One-minute skill: VPNs and Their Limits.

hook.text: A VPN ad promises 'total online privacy.' The VPN company itself logs and sells your browsing data. Ironic.

buildup.text: VPNs create an encrypted tunnel for internet traffic, hiding your activity from your internet provider.

discovery.text: A VPN shifts trust from your ISP to the VPN provider. If the VPN logs data, your privacy hasn't improved — just moved.

twist.text: Many VPN companies are owned by data-collection firms. 'No-log' claims are often unverified marketing.

climax.text: VPNs are one tool, not a solution. Combined with other practices, they help. Alone, they're often misleading.

punchline.text: A VPN hides you from your ISP. But who's hiding you from the VPN?

quiz.question: What is a key limitation of VPN services?
options: They shift trust to the VPN provider, who may log and sell data
